description: Abstract class providing common functionality for protocol adapters in the Eclipse Ditto project, including header processing, type determination, and message mapping.

classes.name: AbstractAdapter
classes.description: Provides common functionality for protocol adapters, including message conversion, header handling, and type extraction.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an external Adaptable message into a typed Jsonifiable object, handling header filtering and type mapping.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a signal into an Adaptable message, adding headers as needed.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type string of an Adaptable based on its topic path and payload.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Extracts the criterion part of the topic path, defaulting to the criterion's name.

methods.name: headerTranslator
methods.description: Returns the HeaderTranslator used for header mapping.
